extension_policy: closed-v1-records; namespaced extensions require a later profile version

dependency.rules: task references must exist; self-links and directed cycles are forbidden; absolute lag is at most 31536000000 milliseconds

event.rules: project_id is optional but must reference an existing project; timing and recurrence follow this manifest

task.rules: project_id is optional but must reference an existing project; due must not precede start; progress is 0 through 100

recurrence.by_weekday: weekly-only, unique, at most seven; empty means the start weekday
recurrence.termination: exactly one of count 1 through 10000 or timed until_ms within ten years

temporal_policy.all_day: ISO-8601 YYYY-MM-DD start and exclusive end; recurrence uses count
temporal_policy.timed: UTC epoch milliseconds; end follows start; recurrence uses UTC arithmetic; time_zone is presentation metadata
